title: Lake Hill Administrative Site Affordable Housing Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Lake Hill Administrative Site Affordable Housing Act - Directs the Secretary of Agriculture (USDA) to convey to Summit County, Colorado, all interest of the United States in the approximately 40 acres of National Forest System land in the county identified as the Lake Hill Administrative Site.

Makes Summit County responsible for the processing and transaction costs related to the direct sale of the land.

Requires the proceeds received from such conveyance to be made available for capital improvement and maintenance of Forest Service facilities in Region 2 of the Forest Service.
